details.failure_summary: Timeout waiting for 'Manage Permissions' modal locator to appear (10000ms exceeded) during permission setup steps
details.reasoning: The test failed consistently across all 3 retry attempts with the same TimeoutError: 'Locator.wait_for: Timeout 10000ms exceeded' on steps 'Open Manage Permissions modal' and 'Add permission exception'. This is not a flaky/infra issue — it reproducibly fails every attempt. The sibling test (test_read_only_permission_allows_get_blocks_write_operations) has the identical failure pattern and is already tracked under issue #2403, strongly suggesting both tests are affected by the same underlying product bug where the Manage Permissions modal UI element is not rendering or is inaccessible.
